…inst the replay family

A spike artifact under agents/islands/scan/pilot/updater/, not an island member: frozen
dataclasses from the gh wire (gh_types.py), a GitHub Protocol with GhCli (the one subprocess
site) and Recorded (serves a replay world, records the action stream), pure clause predicates +
one run() shell (updater.py), and a parametrized pytest over the family's rows.psv labelled
rule() from specs/updater.md. 43/43 rows pass; the bash family passes 43/43 in the same session;
7 of 9 mutations go red on the rows that pin them, 2 are invisible to the harness by construction.

README carries the line-count table (~3x the bash in code lines, 2.4x without the test double),
the 12 bash findings the port surfaced (3 arguable bugs, 2 deliberate divergences), the harness
format subtleties, the 27/43 spec-row mapping, and the open fixture-shape question: the worlds
are hand-trimmed (7 of 12 PR keys) so only 4 fields can be required; the proposed direction is
full data on the wire, a rendered subset on the page. ADR-113 revisit material; nothing in
production changes.

commits.messageBody:
…er family

Tests the "raw world is always full data, the page renders a subset" direction on one family.
recorder.py runs the script's own gh argv against a live repo (6 calls + 2 anonymous REST GETs,
read-only), sanitises the answer mechanically (repo, logins, titles, bodies, URLs) and stamps a
provenance.yaml per world; fullshape.py builds a copy of the updater family whose every PR carries
all 12 --json keys, using the live recording as the shape template and the trimmed world as the
persona source (1553 keys filled, fill-log.json); render.py projects a row's persona from the jq
paths the scripts read.

Result: bash harness 43/43 on the full-shape copy; the Python port with ALL 12 fields required
43/43 on the copy and 0/43 on the original trimmed family; every patch still changes the base.
Findings from the controls: a missing `author` meant "not Renovate" (43 rows), a missing `reviews`
meant "unreviewed" (2 rows), a missing recording is indistinguishable from the garbage-file HOLD,
three board PRs are CHANGES_REQUESTED with no reviews, two stub keys share one file, and the
fixtures spell bot logins in forms live gh never sends on that read. The real family is untouched
(the pin-vacuity gate would not have fired; a spike should not replace a live world anyway).
